name: async-collection
description: The PCE caps a synchronous GET collection at 500 objects and silently truncates past it. This drives the whole documented escape hatch: the plain GET returns exactly 500, which is indistinguishable from a truncated estate, so the same collection is re-issued with Prefer: respond-async, the PCE answers 202 with a Location header naming the job, the job is polled until it reports done, and the result is downloaded from the datafile href it publishes. 505 workloads exist and all 505 must import -- one more asset than the synchronous call could ever return is the whole point. Services are off so the run is one request per stage rather than one per workload.

log_contains: the synchronous collection returned the 500 object cap
